description: Explore the concepts and techniques of data mining, a promising and flourishing frontier in data science. Understand automated extraction of useful information/patterns from large databases, data warehouses and other massive data repositories. Provide a broad understanding in the design and use of data mining algorithms. Provide algorithmic as well as application perspectives of data mining.

syllabus.title: Data Mining and Data Pre-processing
syllabus.body: Introduction to Data Mining, motivation, data mining tasks, issues in data mining applications. Types of data, data quality, data pre-processing, similarity and dissimilarity, outlier analysis.

syllabus.title: Clustering
syllabus.body: Introduction, applications, K-Means algorithm, hierarchical algorithms, density based algorithms, fuzzy c-Mean algorithm, silhouette coefficient, DB-Index.

syllabus.title: Association Rule Mining
syllabus.body: Introduction, applications, market-basket analysis, frequent itemsets, Apriori algorithm, alternative methods, FP Growth algorithm.

syllabus.title: Dimension Reduction and Introduction to Analytics
syllabus.body: Feature selection techniques, Principal Component Analysis, classification overview.

syllabus.title: Web Data Mining
syllabus.body: Social Network Analysis: preliminaries and properties, homophily, triadic closure, clustering coefficient, centrality, community detection in graphs and networks.

outcomes: Choose appropriate data pre-processing techniques based on the given data.
Identify and design an appropriate data mining analysis technique given a problem.
Gain practical hands-on experience in implementing data mining algorithms.
textbooks: Tan, Pang-Ning & others, Introduction to Data Mining, Pearson Education, 2006.
referenceBooks: Han J & Kamber M, Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques, Morgan Kaufmann Publishers, Second Edition, 2006.
Christopher Bishop, Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning, Springer International Edition.
Charu C. Aggarwal, Outlier Analysis, Springer International Publishing (2017).
